entries.zh: 缴纳赋税；完纳钱粮（纳税）
entries.en: to pay tribute / taxes (to hand in the money-and-grain tax)
entries.notes: 「lap búy」未能确释（或为「纳尾」＝付清尾数），「钱粮」＝赋税甚明，释义以西语 pagar tributos 与「纳」字为据

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字「酥」与闽音写 chó lè 不谐（音近「租例」＝租金例费之读），西语 Benef.o（beneficio 缩写）所指不明，互不相合，无法定夺

entries.en: money paid for lodging; inn charges
to pay / settle the lodging fee
to pay what is justly owed; to settle repayment fairly
to repay with restitution; to compensate and pay back
to pay compensation on another's behalf

entries.zh: 按期偿还赊欠（克期赔付）
entries.en: to pay a debt incurred on credit by the agreed term
entries.notes: 汉字「巳」与闽音写 quy 不合，疑为「期（克期＝限定期日）」或「己」形近之写；西语 fio＝赊账信用，释义依赖推断

entries.zh: 经过、路过；沿途逐处经行
entries.en: to pass through, going along place after place on the road
to settle a debt in full, paid on time
entries.notes: 第二字标[疑:扔/切]未能确释；依「清」＝清偿与西语 con puntualidad（如期缴纳）定释

entries.en: to pay the tribute tax (weighing out the money-and-grain levy)
to pay the full amount; to make up the full quota
entries.notes: 西语「pagar por dos los deme」残讹（或为 los demás），释义依汉字「足额」与闽音写 chiog gieg 定释

entries.en: to pay the full sum; to make up the number
entries.notes: 西语残讹同上条，释义依汉字「足数」与闽音写 chiog siau 定释

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字「消碑」与闽音写 siāu pāy 不成义（疑为「消赔／销赔」＝偿清注销，或「消牌」＝注销户牌），西语「.12. taes por el mas a caso」残讹，无法定夺

entries.en: newly received silver; fresh receipts of money
entries.notes: 西语「pagar el pres lo patente」残讹，释义依汉字「新收银」与闽音写 sīn sīū gīn 定释

entries.zh: 身做身当（自作自当）；罪责自负，不牵累他人
entries.en: each bears what he himself has done; to pay for one's own fault without harming others
entries.notes: 「佐/舵」依音写 chô/tām 当为「做/担」之讹或俗写，身做身担当＝自作自当，与西语「自偿己罪而不害他人」相合

entries.en: to pay for sin, redeeming its penalty; redemption of sins
betrothal silver; bride-price
entries.notes: 西语「el q̃to」缩写未确展（或为 quarto「四分之一份」），释义依汉字「聘银」与闽音写 pēng gīn 定释

entries.en: to settle the betrothal by payment (pay the betrothal money)
entries.notes: 「q̃to」缩写未确展，闽音写后段「tē siā̃」未能确释，释义依汉字「定聘」定释

entries.zh: 出粮、发饷（发给兵丁口粮饷银）
entries.en: to pay the soldiers; to issue rations and wages
entries.notes: 汉字「粜」与闽音写 niō 不合（niō 当为「粮」，同本页第11条钱粮之「粮」），出粮＝发饷；后段「lōā pōng niō̃」未能确释

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语疑为 pagar de contado（付现）之讹，汉字「吊水交关」不成词（交关＝买卖交易，「吊水」或为「头水」之讹），整体释义存疑

entries.zh: 强迫偿债（追讨并交付债主）
entries.en: to force repayment of a debt; to dun the debtor and pay the creditor
entries.notes: 闽音写「gûip」对「给」未能确证，释义依「追…主」与西语 por fuerza la deuda 定释
